compose_lie_group_elements: compose two LieGroup elements together and optionally compute their Jacobians
compute_between_lie_groups: compute the relative transformation between two LieGroup elements with Jacobian support
exp_map_tangent_to_lie_group: map a tangent vector to a LieGroup element using the exponential map
log_map_lie_group_to_tangent: map a LieGroup element to its tangent space using the logarithmic map
inverse_lie_group_element: compute the inverse of a LieGroup element with optional Jacobian computation
